text:
maya: Heads-up: customer reported duplicated stream output after a 429 triggered an auth refresh + automatic retry. Saw repeated partial chunks.

simon: Yikes. Minimal repro?

maya: Repro steps: start stream, proxy returns 429 mid-stream, client refreshes token and retries whole request. Logs: `chunk seq=7 status=partial` -> `auth refresh ok` -> `client retry resume=false` -> seq7..end repeated.

niko: Classic blind replay. Fixes: (1) conservative default retry for streaming, (2) server-side resume token so clients can resume instead of replay, (3) jittered exponential backoff.

niko: Example backoff (pseudo): `base = isStreaming ? 500ms : 100ms; sleep = base * 2**attempt * random(0.7,1.3)`. Streaming base higher.

kevin: SDK plan: add `X-Resume-Token` (server emits at commit points) and `X-Replay-Allowed: true|false`. SDK behavior: if streaming and no resume token or `X-Replay-Allowed:false`, do NOT auto-retry on 429; surface to app. If resume token present, send it on retry to resume.

kevin: SDK API idea: `client.stream({resumeStore, idempotencyKey?})` where resumeStore persists last token. On reconnect send `X-Resume-Token`.

maya: For onboarding sample, show both naive (what causes duplicates) and correct pattern with resume + jitter. I'll add sample snippets to docs.

kevin: Also add tests that simulate mid-stream 429 + token refresh to assert no duplicate emission when resume token used. And test that `X-Replay-Allowed:false` prevents SDK retry.

devex-bot: CI: integration streaming-retries flaky on PR #418: https://ci.internal/418

simon: Follow-ups: add telemetry `streaming.replay_attempt` and `streaming.duplicate_emitted`, doc Dedicated/Private opt-out for resume tokens, and retention semantics for resume tokens.

maya: I'll open tickets: DOCS-129 (sample + guidance), SDK-290 (resume headers + conservative streaming defaults), METRICS-78 (streaming replay telemetry). Assigning: @kevin SDK work, @maya docs/sample, @niko policy text. Reopen if CI reproduces. :thumbsup:
